note: Feasibility gate of the slim grader image (grader/Dockerfile, requirements.txt of 28 September 2026) on the 121 tasks of the paper's live pool (socialmas/data/bcb-live-pool.json), run locally under linux/amd64 emulation: the canonical solution passes and an empty body fails for every task, as on the official image bigcodebench/bigcodebench-evaluate:v0.2.4 used by the paper. A first build without openpyxl (an indirect dependency of pandas' Excel writer used by one test) had failed BigCodeBench/409; the fix is the reason the requirements list keeps every non-heavy upstream pin.
